free_tier.stated: No free inference allowance stated: on-demand calls are billed per 1,000 tokens (for example USD 0.0003 per 1,000 input tokens for Amazon Titan Text Lite), and provisioned throughput is billed per model-unit hour.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an AWS account and credentials; OpenAI-compatible access is not native, the vendor's own SDK and REST API are used
chaining: token pricing is the scarce link, with no standing free tier to bridge a workload

limits.value: On-demand billed per 1,000 tokens; no free allowance stated

identity_cost.detail: an AWS account and IAM credentials; the page states no free inference allowance

reliability_note: on-demand pricing only, with no quota exception documented on the pricing page

evidence.proved: on-demand calls are billed per 1,000 tokens with no free allowance stated
